judgments.reason: The model only states that winners gain 3 coins back and that bids ≤3 are self-funding; it does not articulate the specific mechanism that commission is applied before payment so an over-bid (above available coins) can validly win.

The model does not claim or demonstrate that waiting reveals committed rival bids before the focal player commits; it simply observes committed bids becoming visible while the focal player was already committed.

The model follows the stated rule that unresolved lots remain unsold at the eight-round horizon and chooses to close; it does not identify or demonstrate a discrepancy where 'close' settles despite unauctioned lots contrary to rules.
The model describes the auction commission applying to winners but does not articulate or show that catalog purchases receive the three-coin commission intended only for auction wins.
